candidates.explanation: The email-change verification mail builds its link to `<frontendDomain>/confirm-email`, the same page as the sign-up activation mail (userSignUp). The frontend therefore treats the hash as a sign-up confirmation and calls the confirm-email endpoint (AuthService.confirmEmail) instead of the confirm-new-email endpoint (AuthService.confirmNewEmail). The email change is never applied. The path should be `/confirm-new-email`.

fix.description: In MailService.confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'.
